svg.title: tsrs vs bun check vs tsgo
svg.desc: Summed over 17 TypeScript projects · 4 threads each · 4-vCPU Linux machine. Check time: tsrs 29.6 s, bun check 89.1 s, tsgo 118.4 s. Peak memory: tsrs 14.6 GiB, bun check 14.1 GiB, tsgo 36.6 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrs 3.60 s, 1.94 GiB; bun check 6.92 s, 1.42 GiB; tsgo 11.00 s, 5.40 GiB. xstate-main: tsrs 0.45 s, 0.35 GiB; bun check 0.89 s, 0.23 GiB; tsgo 1.63 s, 0.58 GiB. webpack: tsrs 0.77 s, 0.50 GiB; bun check 1.52 s, 0.31 GiB; tsgo 2.85 s, 0.86 GiB. mui-docs: tsrs 2.99 s, 1.17 GiB; bun check 24.51 s, 5.12 GiB; tsgo 13.25 s, 3.67 GiB. Compiler: tsrs 0.15 s, 0.15 GiB; bun check 0.34 s, 0.10 GiB; tsgo 0.40 s, 0.14 GiB. Compiler-Unions: tsrs 0.22 s, 0.17 GiB; bun check 0.63 s, 0.11 GiB; tsgo 0.74 s, 0.16 GiB. cal-diy: tsrs 2.69 s, 1.27 GiB; bun check 7.40 s, 0.84 GiB; tsgo 10.25 s, 3.16 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrs 3.29 s, 1.59 GiB; bun check 7.02 s, 1.25 GiB; tsgo 12.09 s, 4.43 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrs 3.20 s, 1.32 GiB; bun check 8.24 s, 0.82 GiB; tsgo 13.04 s, 3.27 GiB. t3code-server: tsrs 3.53 s, 1.29 GiB; bun check 6.72 s, 0.95 GiB; tsgo 17.10 s, 4.54 GiB. mikro-orm: tsrs 4.01 s, 1.53 GiB; bun check 14.81 s, 0.69 GiB; tsgo 17.85 s, 4.03 GiB. next-packages-next: tsrs 1.13 s, 0.66 GiB; bun check 2.67 s, 0.44 GiB; tsgo 5.11 s, 1.31 GiB. next-root: tsrs 0.85 s, 0.52 GiB; bun check 1.80 s, 0.34 GiB; tsgo 3.06 s, 0.97 GiB. storybook: tsrs 0.73 s, 0.52 GiB; bun check 1.46 s, 0.38 GiB; tsgo 2.81 s, 1.02 GiB. nuxt: tsrs 0.56 s, 0.49 GiB; bun check 1.26 s, 0.35 GiB; tsgo 1.93 s, 0.94 GiB. playwright: tsrs 0.59 s, 0.46 GiB; bun check 1.13 s, 0.31 GiB; tsgo 2.18 s, 0.80 GiB. drizzle-orm: tsrs 0.79 s, 0.63 GiB; bun check 1.79 s, 0.46 GiB; tsgo 3.07 s, 1.31 GiB. tsgo and tsrs with --checkers 4, bun check with --threads 4. Median of 10 interleaved runs (3 for tsgo). tsrs uses PGO-optimized dist build, built like the npm release binaries. Machine: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest (4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9V45 96-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-18 16:55 UTC; tsrs commit 20355caa1e0458049b133372ef6ca31c616f5336. TypeScript 7.1.0-dev.20261018.1; TypeScript reference b85298b6a81f772d080b0455de0ca9d744cd6fd6.
